App Store Connect authentication uses short-lived JWTs generated from your local system time
Apple rejects tokens that expire more than 20 minutes in the future, so even small clock drift can make an otherwise valid key fail

for the shared general cache). If RC and production share the same app ID without separate keys, a restore can reuse compiled output from the previous environment.
Use a cache key per environment

# Production
bunx @capgo/cli@latest build request com.example.app --platform android \
  --cache-key=prod \
  --android-flavor production

# Staging / RC
bunx @capgo/cli@latest build request com.example.app --platform android \
  --cache-key=staging \
  --android-flavor staging
